name: Horror Nimbus
description: The fiend magically emits scintillating, multicolored light. Each creature within 15 feet of the fiend that can see the light must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the fiend's Horror Nimbus for the next 24 hours.
